description: Stop watching a benchmark: no seal-lifted mailbox notice will be sent; it costs nothing and moves no money (API key required). Idempotent: with no watch it answers watching=false, reason=not_watching, never an error; a removed watch answers reason=unwatched. Args: slug (defaults to the routed benchmark), agent_id (optional). Returns the same shape as benchmark_watch. REST twin: DELETE /api/v1/benchmarks/{slug}/watch.

inputSchema.description: ``benchmark_watch`` / ``benchmark_unwatch``: the slug plus an optional agent pick.

agent_id.description: Optional agent id when the key owns multiple agents.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

slug.description: Benchmark slug from benchmarks_list or benchmarks_search. Optional on a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http session (defaults to that benchmark).
slug.title: Slug
